question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Final query: average percentage of LTV in first 7 days, first 30 days, and average total LTV
WITH customer_first AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, p.amount, p.payment_date,
           cf.first_payment,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cf.first_payment)) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_payment,
           SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM customer_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id, first_payment
),
customer_early_sales AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_payment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first <= 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_7days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN hours_since_first <= 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_30days
    FROM customer_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id, first_payment
)
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 THEN 100.0 * ce.sales_7days / cl.total_ltv ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_7days,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 THEN 100.0 * ce.sales_30days / cl.total_ltv ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_30days,
    AVG(cl.total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_ltv cl
JOIN customer_early_sales ce ON cl.customer_id = ce.customer_id AND cl.first_payment = ce.first_payment
WHERE cl.total_ltv > 0
